easyPrerequisites: Iceberg has at least one ice counter on it.
description:
Cast Great Whale by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
When Great Whale enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Repeat.
